Mock interview

A question pops up, you get time to think, then you record your answer. No re-dos once recording starts. Afterwards, watch it back and rate yourself.

These are original practice questions, not JCU's real ones. Set the timings to match your Kira invitation.

Camera

Tap Turn on camera and allow camera and microphone. If live recording isn't allowed here, the app will use your iPhone's camera app instead.

Tips: prop the phone at eye level, face a window, plain background, Do Not Disturb on. Look at the camera lens, not the screen.
